summary: Implemented SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_ROOT with XDG-aware defaults, legacy SGLANG_CACHE_DIR fallback, fixed triton/inductor/torch_compile/deep_gemm layout, per-cache compatibility overrides, import-time DeepGEMM configuration, and protection against later SGLangBackend/Inductor cache relocation. The already-merged SGLANG_CACHE_DIR consolidation was reproduced as incomplete before this change.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_ROOT was absent and InductorAdaptor relocated TRITON_CACHE_DIR and TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR into a graph-local directory. Raw output: reports/j-4763cf8dd78c/evidence/before_cache_contract.txt

22 tests plus 2 subtests covering XDG/default layout, legacy and explicit precedence, native third-party compatibility, clean-process import redirection, DeepGEMM import ordering, and resistance to later Inductor relocation. Raw output: reports/j-4763cf8dd78c/evidence/unit_tests_final.txt

remaining_limitations: No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
DeepGEMM is NVIDIA-only and could not be executed on the assigned ROCm MI355X; its cache precedence and before-import assignment were verified without claiming kernel execution.

CUDA driver and FlashInfer CUDA cache writes could not be exercised on ROCm; their unified-root mapping remains the previously merged setdefault implementation and was inspected in the retained call-site audit.
An explicitly configured SGLANG_DIFFUSION_CACHE_ROOT remains a compatibility override for diffusion torch.compile caches; without that explicit override, diffusion now uses the unified JIT root.

No serving/model fixture was run because this feature is process-level cache configuration and the real GPU compiler check directly exercises the affected Inductor/Triton behavior without model weights.
